verses.en: Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.
verses.pt: Bendizei, pois, ao SENHOR, todos vós servos do SENHOR, que prestais serviço à casa do SENHOR durante as noites.
verses.en_web: Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up.> Give praise to the Lord, all you servants of the Lord, who take your places in the house of the Lord by night.

verses.en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
verses.pt: Levantai vossas mãos ao Santuário, e bendizei ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to the Lord, lifting up your hands in his holy place.

verses.en: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
verses.pt: Que o SENHOR, o criador do céu e da terra, te abençoe desde Sião.
verses.en_web: May Yahweh bless you from Zion; even he who made heaven and earth.
verses.en_bbe: May the Lord, who made heaven and earth, send you blessing out of Zion,
